plan_only.what: solve.sh run with every RECONCILE 'fix' list emptied, so phase 2 can only SELECT. Reward is earned by MCP tool calls alone -- the action space a real agent has.

discovery_gate.what: every identifier-shaped argument must trace to a prompt, a strictly earlier tool response, or a computation the ground truth explains.

golden_replay.what: golden.json's OWN tool calls executed against a fresh environment, fixes disarmed. plan-only proves the TASK is solvable; this proves the SFT ARTIFACT still reproduces it. It matters because golden.json stores literal args while solve.sh threads run-time generated ids through ${var} -- a task chaining on one could rot silently.

caveats: Gyms were the locally available images; a port-alias sidecar and the harness-era /api/seed-database endpoint were used to bring them up. Shipped bundle bytes were not modified — the adaptation is a compose override.
Reward 1.0 is the ORACLE's path. It proves the task is solvable, not easy; see SHIPPED_TASKS_SUMMARY.md for measured model results.
